value.rationale: A natural detection network on the classical cubic Pappus graph exhibits a genuine rigidity-to-mobility threshold: minimum closed-neighborhood identifying configurations split into two giant disconnected components even under unrestricted one-for-one sensor relocation, but permitting a single additional sensor yields connected fixed-size reconfiguration. The complete all-cardinality census, exact component geometry and natural two-side point/line obstruction provide motivated, nontrivial structural information beyond the identifying-code number. Finite graph scope is sufficient to establish a complete classification with a clear reconfiguration application.
